description: Live mode only. Take the human's game back (or forward, within the known session) to `tick`: the page reloads, replays the session's inputs to that tick and stays paused, so the state is exactly what it was then. Use a note's `tick` to look at the moment the human flagged. The page needs a second to reload; then use game_state or game_capture.

tick.description: Tick to go to, e.g. a note's tick.

name: game_rewind
title: Rewind the live game
